note: The closest match to the stated ICP in this batch and arguably the textbook case. Owns a digital products business selling real estate courses in France, employs closers, and sells at a higher price point than Primal does ('our products is more expensive than you guys') — successful and income are both satisfied, and he confirmed the second directly: 'I'm not even debating the price' and 'It's worth it.' Health is precisely the neglected area rather than a crisis: 'I was focused on my company. I was like, okay, later, later, later.' The good-to-great framing is his own — 'I'm not fat. I'm not, but I'd like to have like more muscles that we can see' — and he explicitly rejects the bodybuilder end as well as the deconditioned one. Not deconditioned: boxing twice a week until March, tennis, a self-run circuit programme, self-estimated 16-20% body fat. The finding here runs the opposite way to the corpus pattern in data/icp.json: this is a core-ICP, price-insensitive buyer who did not close, and the blocker was not fit, income or belief but the absence of any written description of the offer.
